{"code": "sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop invalid revenue entries
sales_df = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Check if the data is clean
print("Cleaned data shape:", sales_df.shape)
print("No missing values:", sales_df.isnull().sum().sum())
print("No duplicates:", sales_df.duplicated().sum())

# Compute overall conversion rate
overall_conversion = sales_df['converted'].mean()

# Compute average revenue per order
avg_revenue = sales_df['revenue'].mean()

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = sales_df['revenue'].sum()

# Check conversion rate by channel
conversion_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Check conversion rate by customer segment
conversion_by_segment = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Check for confounding: are channels and segments balanced?
print("Cross-tabulation of channel and customer segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment']))"}
